clarification: These are commercial/product service tiers, NOT GCSE/IGCSE/A Level academic levels.

weekly.name: Grove Weekly
weekly.student_goal: Build consistent exam technique and identify weaknesses.

AS_A_LEVEL.topic_mix: Pure / statistics / mechanics by assigned pathway

weekly.assessment_workflow: Each question receives typed, whiteboard or photographic evidence; human marking/report when available
weekly.calendaring: One suggested day each week; scheduler to be implemented
weekly.status: pilot question bank; not full board-calibrated sets

daily.name: Grove Daily
daily.cadence: Seven days of short practice each week, plus Weekly sets
daily.student_goal: Target specific errors and make mathematical working routine.

GCSE.topic_mix: One micro-skill, then one reasoning check

IGCSE.topic_mix: Cambridge or Pearson technique and short justification

daily.assessment_workflow: Topic recovery based on examiner feedback; no automatic high-stakes marking of handwritten proof
daily.calendaring: Seven-day suggested schedule, no emails or auto assignment yet
daily.status: existing student builder supports short practice; content expansion pending

exam.name: Grove Exam
exam.cadence: Everything in Grove Daily plus one approved timed mock monthly
exam.student_goal: Practice exam conditions and gather moderated evidence of readiness.

GCSE.topic_mix: Full-board marks, AO and calculator mapping

exam.assessment_workflow: Administrator-authored, approved, published and assigned original paper; server hard-stop mock session; examiner review
exam.calendaring: One real mock per calendar month once approved pack available
exam.status: backend and web UI prepared, SQL deployment and moderation required
